source.provenance: Drafted by an AI model for the course; not reviewed by a native speaker. It is controlled, deliberately repetitive Standard Albanian written for learners and may contain unnatural or incorrect phrasing. Every word form was checked by machine against the course's own word list, the UniParser Albanian analyzer and Wiktionary's Albanian tables (npm run sq:check-texts); that is a check of forms, not of naturalness, and forms on which those sources differ are listed in data/review/sq/accepted-differences.json. The English lines are the drafter's own.

sentences.text: Gjyshi dhe gjyshja jetojnë në fshat.
sentences.english: The grandfather and the grandmother live in the village.

sentences.text: Shtëpia e gjyshit është e vjetër, por e bukur.
sentences.english: The grandfather's house is old, but beautiful.

sentences.text: Gjyshi ka një qen të madh.
sentences.english: The grandfather has a big dog.
The grandmother makes bread every day.

sentences.text: Buka e gjyshes është shumë e mirë.
sentences.english: The grandmother's bread is very good.

sentences.text: Beni dhe Ana shkojnë në fshat çdo verë.
sentences.english: Beni and Ana go to the village every summer.

sentences.text: Ata i duan gjyshin dhe gjyshen.
sentences.english: They love the grandfather and the grandmother.
